card.name: Section number starting after a sentence
card.fires_on: The first digit of a new section or subsection number (like 2 in 2.1 or 2.2) that comes right after a full stop, often after a bracketed cross-reference. Also fires on the blank space just before a number that opens a new section or table row.

modes.label: Section number after cross-reference
modes.description: A leading digit of a numbered heading right after a sentence that ends in a bracketed section reference.
